meta.name: battle-card-builder
meta.description: Research and draft a competitive battle card from public evidence — every claim labeled and sourced. Use when a rep needs a field-action card, not a research report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成带来源标注的竞争分析卡片
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果销售团队需要快速获取可验证的竞争情报。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly draft competitive battle cards with sourced claims.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your sales team needs fast, verifiable competitive intelligence.

howto.what: 给定你的产品和一家竞争对手,Claude 会搜集公开信息(定价页、评论、发布说明),生成一张销售现场用的对战卡。卡上每个主张都标了来源网址和“事实/推断/假设”类型。
howto.when: 当销售需要一份现场对战卡(而不是研究报告)时触发;典型场景是用户提出为某个产品对某家竞品“建一张 battle card”,或要求把已有竞争快照变成卡片。

say.text: 帮我做一张对战卡:我们的平台 vs 竞品A,对标中端市场运营负责人。
say.note: 它会直接收集公开资料并起草卡片。

say.text: 用这份竞争快照生成 battle card,超过一个季度的信息重新查。
say.note: 它复用现有证据,只补缺口。

say.text: 为最近三次输单做竞品对战卡,每条主张都要有来源。
say.note: 它按模板产出带证据表的卡片。

howto.what_en: Given a product and a competitor, Claude gathers public evidence and drafts a battle card. Every claim is labeled Fact/Inference/Assumption with a source URL. Suitable for a rep's 30-second read.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a rep needs a field-action battle card, not a research report — e.g., user asks to build a battle card for product vs competitor. Claude checks session intel and asks up to 3 questions.

say_en.text: Build a battle card: our platform vs Competitor A, mid-market ops.
say_en.note: Starts public research and drafts the card.

say_en.text: Turn this competitive snapshot into a battle card; refresh stale items.
Make a competitor card for our last three losses, with every claim sourced.
say_en.note: Produces a labeled card with an evidence table.
